repos.description: AI 每日新闻简报 · GitHub 热门 + X 热门文章 + 行情技术分析 · 23 个数据源聚合 + LLM 中文摘要 · 本地或 GitHub Actions 部署
repos.summary_zh: DailyBrief 是一款 AI 驱动的每日新闻简报工具，聚合 GitHub、X（推特）、财经及国际媒体等 23 个数据源，支持 21 个股票/加密标的的技术指标与 LLM 中文摘要。核心亮点包括：5 种可插拔 LLM 后端（Claude/OpenAI/DeepSeek/MiniMax）、中英双语支持、零基础设施的 GitHub Actions 一键部署，以及单文件 HTML 无依赖输出。适用于个人投资者、技术极客及资讯聚合场景，实现自动化、个性化的每日简报生成。
repos.summary_en: DailyBrief is an AI-powered daily news briefing tool that aggregates content from 23 sources including GitHub, X (Twitter), financial and international media. It features real-time technical indicators for 21 stocks/crypto assets with LLM-generated Chinese summaries. Key highlights: 5 plug-and-play LLM backends (Claude/OpenAI/DeepSeek/MiniMax), bilingual support, zero-infrastructure deployment via GitHub Actions, and standalone HTML output. Ideal for investors, tech enthusiasts, and automated information aggregation.

repos.description: GithubAction的使用样例，天气推送，薅羊毛，打卡签到
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 GitHub Actions 实战样例，演示如何通过无服务器 Python 程序实现自动化任务。核心功能包括跨平台画爱心程序构建、微信公众号天气推送及京东签到薅羊毛。通过 Secrets 管理敏感信息，支持定时任务调度，适合学习 CI/CD 与自动化运维。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides practical examples of GitHub Actions for serverless automation. Key features include cross-platform executable generation (e.g., drawing hearts), weather push notifications via WeChat Official Account, and JD.com daily check-in 'money-saving' bots. It uses GitHub Secrets for secure credential management and cron-based scheduling.

repos.summary_zh: flow.ci 是一个开源的持续集成与部署平台，提供中英文双语文档和公开的问题追踪系统，旨在帮助开发者高效管理 CI/CD 流程，支持自动化构建、测试与部署。
repos.summary_en: flow.ci is an open-source continuous integration and deployment platform offering bilingual documentation (English and Chinese) and a public issue tracker to help developers streamline CI/CD workflows with automation.

repos.description: 工作生活的唠叨/随笔、折腾备忘, 同时分享下观看的影视、减肥动起来的记录等。Hugo theme and personal blog system with essays, microblog-style updates, browser publishing and life data.
repos.summary_zh: Koobai/blog 是一个个人博客仓库，专注于记录工作生活感悟、技术折腾笔记及日常软件推荐。内容涵盖影视观后感、减肥健身打卡等生活化主题，兼具实用性与分享性，适合追求轻量化知识沉淀与兴趣交流的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Koobai/blog is a personal blog repository focused on daily life musings, technical experimentation notes, and software recommendations. It covers topics like movie reviews, fitness tracking, and lifestyle tips, offering a blend of practical insights and casual sharing for developers seeking lightweight knowledge documentation.
